result.releaseSummary: Adds shared floating original animated agent companion with visibility controls and scoped OpenAI chat. Utilizes existing agent store and roles.
risks: {"affectedFile":"app/lib/agents/companion-preferences.ts","issue":"Potential for unauthorized access to agent preferences due to insufficient role checks.","remediation":"Verify that all access checks for user roles are correctly implemented and tested."}

{"affectedFile":"app/api/agents/companion/route.ts","issue":"The POST method allows actions that could be executed by unauthorized users if role checks fail.","remediation":"Ensure that role checks are enforced before any sensitive actions are taken, especially in the POST method."}

{"affectedFile":"app/api/agents/companion/route.ts","issue":"The handling of user roles during asynchronous operations may lead to race conditions.","remediation":"Implement stricter checks to ensure user roles are validated at each async boundary."}
smokeTests: Verify that the floating agent companion appears correctly in the UI.
Check that visibility controls function as expected.
regressionTests: Test existing agent functionalities to ensure no regressions occur.
edgeCases: Test behavior when an editor attempts to access an agent outside their scope.
adminChecks: Verify that admin users can access all functionalities without restrictions.
thirdPartyChecks: Ensure that OpenAI API integration is functioning correctly and that fallback mechanisms are in place.

result.cursorFixPrompt: Review and enhance role validation checks in both the read and write operations for agent preferences. Ensure that all asynchronous operations validate user roles correctly to prevent unauthorized access.
